gameName: 米游社 / HoYoLAB / 森空岛 / SKPORT / 库街区游戏签到

items: 新增崩坏3的米游社与 HoYoLAB 游戏内签到。
新增森空岛明日方舟与终末地、SKPORT终末地国际服、库街区鸣潮与战双帕弥什游戏内签到。
新增五个平台独立凭据、状态、签到游戏选择和用户列表聚合徽章。
将用户配置规范化为 schema v3，并保留既有米游社与 HoYoLAB 状态记录。
新增宿主语言资源，支持中英文界面显示。
修复商店展示元数据 JSON 的尾逗号，避免宿主重复记录解析警告。

en-US.gameName: Miyoushe / HoYoLAB / Skland / SKPORT / Kuro game check-in
en-US.description: When a user script starts, check in selected games in-game across five supported platforms and show aggregated status in the user list.

items: Added in-game check-in for Honkai Impact 3rd on Miyoushe and HoYoLAB.
Added in-game check-in for Arknights and Endfield on Skland, Endfield global on SKPORT, and Wuthering Waves and Punishing: Gray Raven on Kuro.
Added independent credentials, state, game selection, and aggregated user-list badges for five platforms.
Normalized user settings to schema v3 while retaining existing Miyoushe and HoYoLAB state records.
Added host language resources for Chinese and English interfaces.
Fixed a trailing comma in the store metadata JSON to prevent duplicate parse warnings in the host.
